name: A Darker Truth
summary: Muln Earthfury asks you to bring him a letter recovered at Gloomrise. It may shed light on the spiders there.

sections.title: A Letter at Gloomrise
sections.body: At Gloomrise, you have found that the Broodmother was a night elf druid in a twisted animal form. Questions remain about the spiders and their purpose. A note from her robe may hold answers, so you carry it to Muln Earthfury at Skywatcher Plateau.

sections.title: Muln's Concern
sections.body: Muln Earthfury finds the letter disturbing. It speaks of a “Wild King” and a “Pact,” though he does not know who or what they are. He plans to consult the Cenarion Circle, while taking comfort that the one controlling the spiders is gone.

faq.answer: The Broodmother was a night elf druid who had taken a twisted animal form.

faq.q: What do I bring to Muln Earthfury?
faq.answer: You bring Muln Earthfury the letter recovered from Broodmother Valraxx's robe.

faq.q: Where do I take the letter?
faq.answer: You take the letter to Muln Earthfury at Skywatcher Plateau.

faq.q: What does Muln make of the letter?
faq.answer: Muln finds it disturbing and wonders about its references to a “Wild King” and a “Pact.”
Muln plans to speak with the druids of the Cenarion Circle.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Darker Truth
